column2: There's somewhere I'd like to stop by. Do you mind?{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, there may be an incident to deal with... Could we do it another time?{wait}{clear}
I see... That's fine. We'll go next time.{wait}{clear}
Yes, of course, that's fine.{wait}{clear}
Really? Thanks.{wait}{clear}
It won't take long.{wait}{clear}
This is the tower where my master and I lived.{wait}{clear}
It's been a long time since I came back...{wait}{clear}
Looks like Irene isn't here...{wait}{clear}
What sort of person is she?{wait}{clear}
She's Zig's granddaughter, and like a little sister to me.{wait}{clear}
She's lived here all along...{wait}{clear}
She doesn't seem to be in. She must have gone out on some errand.{wait}{clear}
I wanted to see her...{wait}{clear}
Can't be helped...{wait}{clear}
This brings back memories... Nothing's changed.{wait}{clear}
We came here to see Irene.{wait}{clear}
This brings back memories... It hasn't changed.{wait}{clear}
But Irene still seems to be bad at tidying up.{wait}{clear}
Going out and leaving it this messy...{wait}{clear}
Heh, come to think of it, Serenis used to scold her for that all the time...{wait}{clear}
There are a lot of memories here.{wait}{clear}
I learned all sorts of things under Zig.{wait}{clear}
And... the days I spent with Serenis and Irene...{wait}{clear}
It feels like it was so very long ago.{wait}{clear}
I didn't feel that way until I came back...{wait}{clear}
Here, I can feel the passage of time...{wait}{clear}
This place probably hasn't changed...{wait}{clear}
